scope: National Assembly elections of 21 June 2020 and 25 October 2026, all 250 seats (one nationwide constituency): votes and seats per electoral list, voters on the roll, voters who voted, valid and invalid ballots, from the Republic Electoral Commission total-results reports. The 2022 and 2023 elections, polling-station and municipal results, list kinds, national-minority status, party attribution and candidate names are not covered.

owner_decisions.decision: Owner reply "start everything" (Serbia decisions C and D).
Owner reply "批准登记这五个塞尔维亚站点，仅人工读取": www.rik.parlament.gov.rs, www.parlament.gov.rs, the legal information system, www.mfin.gov.rs and www.nbs.rs registered for manual reading only.
Owner reply "批准下载，选 a": one download each of the 2020 RIK report and totals (kept in local-evidence, never committed); 2022/2023/2026 to be sought through the registered legal information system.
Owner reply "选 b，两个都做，先 D": list labels by rule (b) (no full titles; parties named in the title, or row number only; verbatim only when no person is named); build both C and D.

reuse_right.basis: Copyright and Related Rights Act Art. 6(2): official materials of state bodies are not copyright works (read 2026-11-15 on the official legal information system). The RIK reports are official materials of a state body. Recorded as a reading of the statute, weaker than a licence; the RIK site footer states CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 Serbia for the web presentation, which the Atlas does not republish.

normalized_republication.basis: National figures only (registers, voters, ballots, votes and seats per list), transcribed from one official report per election; no database extraction (database-maker right, Act Art. 1 and 5a); attribution to RIK.

raw_redistribution.basis: The 2020 report file and the 2026 page text are kept in local-evidence/ and identified by checksum; full list titles are not committed (title_sha256 only), per owner rule (b).

acquisition_route.basis: Hosts registered for manual reading only; one robots.txt request each (RIK: no robots.txt, error page). 2020: one download each of the named report and totals file (owner-approved). 2026: RIK notice of session 75 read by hand in a browser. The results application and its data endpoints were not requested; the Official Gazette text (subscriber login) was not accessed.

source_files_complete.basis: Each report prints registered voters, voters who voted, ballots, invalid and valid ballots and every list with votes and seats; all are transcribed.

national_definition_complete.basis: List votes equal valid ballots; invalid plus valid equal the printed ballot count (2020: ballots used; 2026: voters who voted); 2020 ballots received equal unused ballots plus voters who voted; seats total 250. Turnout is derived (voters who voted / roll) and labelled as such.

same_election_identity_complete.basis: Each list keeps its printed row and a title checksum; labels follow owner rule (b). No list is linked to a party or across elections; continuous_series_eligible is false for every list.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: Law on the Election of Members of Parliament (14/2022, 47/2026) Arts. 5, 128, 129 and 140 quoted in the evidence record. The printed seats of both elections reproduce under highest quotients over 250 seats with the 3% threshold and the 35% minority quotient increase; for 2020 this is a consistency check only, because the 2020 statute version was not read.

vintage_decisions_complete.basis: Each report is the commission’s final determination of the total results after the repeated voting (2020: adopted 5 July 2020; 2026: adopted 5 November 2026, published in Službeni glasnik RS 107/2026).

continuity: None: no party register was reviewed, so no link is made between 2020 and 2026, even where a label repeats. continuous_party_series is 0.
